blocks: Cost-aware deployment decisions (FFMx measurement for open models)
work_statement: Build Prometheus metrics exporter for token cost tracking across Claude API + open models. Faerie2 measures FFMx (context utilization efficiency) for Claude; open models need equivalent token-per-task metrics. Create exporter that: (1) hooks manifest writes to extract token counts (input_tokens, output_tokens, cache usage), (2) emits Prometheus metrics per agent_type + model + investigation_label, (3) calculates cost per manifest (Claude API tokens vs. Ollama inference cost), (4) enables FFMx dashboard for open models vs. Claude baseline.

context.current_metrics: faerie2 tracks context_fill, manifest_truthfulness, belief_index. FFMx (context × discovery_yield / token_burn) is Claude-specific.
context.prometheus_scope: Lightweight exporter, NOT full Prometheus infrastructure. Expose metrics via /metrics endpoint on localhost:9090.
context.cost_inputs: Claude API: token prices per model. Ollama: free (but measure GPU inference time for cost simulation).
context.success_criterion: Prometheus dashboard shows FFMx comparison: Claude Agent() vs. Ollama (llama2-70b) + Celery bridge for same tasks. Goal: ±10% accuracy.

deliverables: dashboards/ffmx-comparison.json — Grafana dashboard for cost tracking
docs/token-metering-setup.md — How to enable metrics collection
